item.title: Netanyahu's party puts Mamdani alongside Iran, Hezbollah leaders on billboard
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's party placed Mayor Mamdani's image on a billboard. This billboard featured Mamdani alongside leaders hostile to Israel's interests. Netanyahu is campaigning for re-election amid political challenges in Israel. He has increasingly used Mamdani's criticism as campaign messaging. The exchange occurs while Gaza ceasefire efforts remain stalled.

item.title: 1,300 Swiss villagers face danger as thawing glaciers loosen a massive Alpine rock
item.description: Kandersteg village in Switzerland faces a significant landslide threat from an unstable mountain. Scientists link this danger to thawing permafrost and changing glacier dynamics caused by climate change. While the threat is not immediate, authorities have prepared evacuation plans and monitoring systems. Residents are aware of the risks but remain calm, trusting the implemented safety measures. This situation highlights the increasing natural risks faced by mountain communities globally.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A rotating 'garbage island' spreads over 1.6 million sq km in the Pacific with 50 kilograms of plastic per square kilometre
item.description: Between the shores of Hawaii and California floats a staggering 1.6 million square kilometers of plastic debris. This island of waste includes not just nets and ropes but also countless microplastics that pose serious threats to marine wildlife. Animals often mistake plastics for food, while others become trapped in ghost fishing gear.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Kansas couple builds tornado-resistant home from tyres, cans and boxes
item.description: In an innovative twist on sustainable living, a couple in Kansas is transforming discarded items into a unique residence. This Earthship features around 1,000 tires and 16,000 aluminum cans, built to endure severe weather, including tornadoes and fires. It will autonomously generate power, harvest rainwater, and process wastewater, demonstrating how waste can be creatively repurposed into a haven.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 1993, an art historian found a forgotten painting; 33 years later, its female creator was rediscovered
item.description: A remarkable find by an art historian in 1993 ignited a relentless pursuit to recover the lost masterpieces of Michaelina Wautier. This accomplished 17th-century painter's works had long been misattributed to men throughout history. The pivotal recovery of her 'The Five Senses' series in 2020 heralded a new era, culminating in a landmark exhibition at London's Royal Academy in 2026, finally restoring her rightful legacy after centuries in the shadows.

item.title: Imran Khan’s sister meets him after 9 months as Pakistan SC orders hospital transfer for jailed ex-PM
item.description: Noreen Niazi met her brother Imran Khan in Adiala Jail after nine months. The Supreme Court ordered weekly family meetings and his transfer to a hospital. Imran also met his wife, Bushra Bibi, for a longer duration. Medical reports indicated fluctuating blood pressure and anxiety for the former prime minister. The court stressed family access as a fundamental right, not a concession.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Democrat Angie Nixon defeats Alexander Vindman in surprise Florida Senate primary upset
item.description: Angie Nixon secured a surprise Democratic Senate primary victory in Florida. She will now face Republican Ashley Moody in the general election. Byron Donalds and David Jolly won their respective governor primary nominations. New congressional maps are expected to favor Republicans significantly. These primaries set the stage for Florida's November political direction.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US vs ICC row escalates: Trump administration sanctions international court president, senior lawyer
item.description: In a significant escalation against the International Criminal Court (ICC), the United States has imposed sanctions on two prominent officials, including the ICC president and a senior trial lawyer. This move marks a continuation of the Trump administration's contentious stance towards the internationally recognized tribunal. The ICC criticized these sanctions as detrimental to the global legal framework, while several European allies voiced their concern over the U.S. actions.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Owens And Wilson Clash: Misogynistic slur ignites Kirk case debate; fractures conservative media
item.description: Candace Owens and Andrew Wilson clashed during a heated three-hour PBD Podcast debate over Charlie Kirk’s assassination and the case against Tyler Robinson. Owens questioned evidence and investigative details while Wilson defended the prosecution’s case. The discussion became more contentious when Owens brought up Wilson’s previous comment about Erika Kirk, Charlie Kirk’s widow. Wilson then made a sweeping and offensive remark about women, intensifying criticism surrounding the debate and its participants.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Streamer Confirms She Is Alive: JollyIRL says she’s hurt after bungee jump; fans reflect on stunt risks
item.description: JollyIRL sparked widespread concern after her bungee jump livestream in Pattaya, Thailand, suddenly ended following a loud scream. The abrupt cutoff left viewers fearing she may have suffered a serious accident. The Kick streamer later confirmed she was alive and said her arm and neck were hurting, with possible whiplash. Fans expressed relief and discussed the risks of bungee jumping, while fellow streamer Sneako also voiced concern after watching the viral clip.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: IShowSpeed Eyes WWE Return: Streamer teases comeback on livestream; Logan Paul feud looms
item.description: IShowSpeed has fueled speculation about another WWE appearance after teasing a return "very soon" during a recent livestream. The streamer last appeared at WrestleMania 42, teaming with Logan Paul and Austin Theory against The Usos and LA Knight. After their defeat, Paul turned on Speed, leading to a dramatic response when Speed drove him through an announce table. His latest tease could potentially set up another WWE storyline or renewed rivalry with Paul.

item.title: A San Francisco man was digging in his backyard when his shovel hit something hard
item.description: While digging in his San Francisco garden, a gardener stumbled upon an intriguing limestone sculpture. Despite consultations with around fifty experts, its origins remain shrouded in mystery. Given its location near an art school, there may be historical ties to the 1939 Golden Gate International Exposition. The enigmatic bust is set to grace the garden as a captivating centerpiece.
